summary: I tested the two-purpose AI Calling enhancement end to end, in dry-run/mock mode only. No calls were placed and the safety switches did not change. Backend live API: 22/22 passed in the new file tests/test_ai_calling_two_purposes_api.py. Covered: GET /scheduling (both purposes, windows, retries, capacity); PUT /scheduling rejecting 11 invalid bodies with 400 (confirm_offset_days 8 and 0, missed_offset_minutes 59 and 10081, concurrent 0 and 51, queue 1001, an unknown key, wrong types, an empty body); PUT without CSRF refused; a valid PUT (confirm_offset_days 2) returning 200 with an audit entry in the DB and 'recalculated', then restored to the defaults. /test-calls/status: single_call_enabled false, min_recipients 1, block_reasons = [Emergency Stop is ON, AI_CALLING_ENABLED=false]. call-now for Syed: wrong name gives 400, correct name gives 409, and ai_calls stays at 1. /alerts lists []. Resolving a bogus or unknown alert gives 404. mock-jobs/{unknown}/process gives 409. mock-run gives 200. worker-status works and includes pending_by_purpose. /live-dispatch/authorize gives 423. Scratch suite: 337 passed, 30 skipped, no flakes. Frontend: the Settings Call Scheduling panel has all 9 testids with the correct defaults. An invalid save shows the error toast, a valid save shows the success toast, and I restored 1/60/20/5/1/50 and checked it after reload. The consent preview shows the v4 text and 'version 2026-06-v4'. Testing page: block reasons are shown. Call Selected is disabled with 0 selected and the reason 'Select at least one test colleague'; with only Syed selected the reason is 'Emergency Stop is ON'. No call-now request was sent. Live Prep: AlertsPanel ('No open alerts.'), mock-run-btn, the purpose column and process buttons on planned rows all render. A process click on a job that is not due shows the 409 toast. Candidate Journey, checked with route mocks: the purpose badge shows 'Missed-interview follow-up' and 'Pre-interview confirmation' (the fallback when purpose is missing), and the flags and missed fields render. No horizontal overflow at 390 on settings, testing, live or the journey modal.

minor.endpoint: Bolna provider extraction check (execution.py disposition check / extraction_config_check)
minor.issue: This check only looks for the original 6 EXTRACTION_FIELDS. The 5 MISSED_FIELDS (missed_interview_outcome, missed_interview_reason, expected_arrival_time, attendance_dispute, ...) are never checked. The Settings diagnostic shows VERIFIED 'all 6 fields found' even if the Bolna agent has no missed follow-up fields configured. It should check ALL_FIELDS (11).
call_purpose is only validated after the gate has run and the dispatch lock has been taken. A bad purpose should be rejected with 400 before any gate or lock work.

The synthetic fixtures never produce a missed_interview_followup job. Fixture consent has no text_version, so its scope lacks the follow-up purpose, and no fixture is a past 'Interview Scheduled'/'Missed' booking with otp_verified ''. As a result the Live Prep purpose column only ever shows 'Confirmation', and the follow-up purpose cannot be checked in the UI.
Readiness compares only the date: Syed's interview at 12:00 IST today had already passed (about 13:28 IST) but still showed 'Ready for test call'. This existed before this change.

ui_bugs.issue: The flag reads 'NO ANSWER' when the call status is 'busy'. The label is misleading; use BUSY or 'NO ANSWER / BUSY'.

integration_issues.issue: The backend returns consent_text_version and consent_scope, but ConsentCard shows neither. HR cannot tell whether a candidate's consent (v3) covers only confirmation or (v4) also covers the missed follow-up.

design_issues.screen: Candidate Journey modal: AI Calling History
issues: The purpose badge (text-violet-300 on bg-violet-900/20) is almost unreadable because the modal has a light beige theme. ProfileCallItem uses dark-theme zinc/violet/cyan colours, so the status and purpose badges have low contrast.
Uses the browser's built-in date and time pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn calendar. This existed before this change.

action_items: Make the Bolna extraction-field verification check all 11 fields (ALL_FIELDS), not only the 6 original EXTRACTION_FIELDS
Validate call_purpose in call-now before gate evaluation and taking the lock
Add a synthetic fixture with v4 consent and a past interview with otp_verified '' (and status 'Missed') so the missed follow-up purpose can be checked in Live Prep
Fix ProfileCallItem badge colours for the light journey modal (purpose badge contrast)
Show consent_text_version and scope in ConsentCard
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: the admin password is 'QAZwsx##123', not 'Admin User'
critical_code_review_comments: execution.py: EXTRACTION_FIELDS (6) is still used for the provider disposition and config checks, while ALL_FIELDS (11) is used only for normalisation
purposes.missed_eligibility line 62: the `if st != 'Missed'` branch can never run, because Missed is in MISSED_STATUSES. Harmless but confusing
dispatch.call_now: purpose validation happens inside the locked try block, after gate.evaluate

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 1 low-priority UI bug, 2 design issues and 1 integration gap found

rca of the issue: The 'all 6 fields found' VERIFIED status comes from execution.py, where verify_dispositions and extraction_config_check iterate EXTRACTION_FIELDS (6) instead of ALL_FIELDS (11).
